answer: Stop sybils with an island raven relic: an agent stakes a bond for one island vault. Each cycle a raven courier carries its relic to verifiers; verifiers check its mark, voiding a vault whose relic is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 vaults at 16x cost each: each relic fits one island vault and one raven flight, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents vault once and keep rights.
